notes: Flashcards grew up: undo, editing in review, cloze filled in place, typing the answer, tags, flags, Study more
Notes with fields and note types of your own, deck options presets, pictures, sounds, maths and image occlusion
Write Chinese characters stroke by stroke, or any script on a free pad
The card browser searches as Anki's does, with a sidebar, columns, find and replace, duplicates and a Stats tab
FSRS can be trained on your own answers (kept only if it predicts them better), with load balancing and easy days
Import a CSV or text file, export as CSV, text or a deck without your progress, and Check the cards
